Required set: all color tokens from §1.2–1.3, plus `--radius-sm: 8px`, `--radius-md: 16px`, `--radius-lg: 28px`, `--shadow-sm`, `--shadow-md`, `--shadow-neu-light`, `--shadow-neu-dark`, `--glass-bg`, `--glass-border`, `--spacing-gap: 1.5rem`, `--spacing-section: clamp(4rem, 10vw, 7.5rem)`, `--transition-fast: 150ms`, `--transition-normal: 320ms`, `--ease-standard: cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.8, 0.25, 1)`, `--z-dropdown: 50`, `--z-modal: 100`, `--z-toast: 150`. No hard-coded colors, shadows, or durations in component rules — always `var(--...)`. **2.3 Mandatory Dark Mode** * **Light mode is this theme's default presentation**, but dark mode must be fully defined and fully functional — every component, gradient, glass panel, and neumorphic shadow must have a verified dark counterpart. * Provide a visible theme toggle (sun/moon Google Material Symbols) in the header with correct `aria-pressed` and `aria-label` states. * Persist choice in `localStorage`; on first visit fall back to `prefers-color-scheme`. Never mix conventions; never invent classes for elements that don't exist. Tailwind utilities are not used in this build. **2.6 Icons — Google Material Symbols Only** Load Google Material Symbols (Outlined) via ``.
